::: {#exm-domain-image}
#### The images of two functions

- The function $\operatorname{len}_K : K \to \Nat$ of @exm-graph-length has the image (@def-image)
  $\operatorname{len}_K(K) = \set{2, 3, 4, 6}$, the lengths that occur.
  Most natural numbers, such as 1 and 5, are in its codomain (@def-codomain) $\Nat$ but not in its image.
- The function $b : G \to G$ of @exm-function-or-not has domain (@def-function-domain) and codomain $G$,
  and its image is all of $G$, since each element of $G$ is beaten by some element.

:::
